requirements.description: Acclaimed chefs often come from prestigious culinary backgrounds that shape their careers. At which restaurant did the head chefs of the restaurant named the world's best by CNN in 2024 meet?
requirements.claim: The restaurant named the world's best by CNN in 2024 is Disfrutar.

requirements.description: Who are the head chefs of Disfrutar and where did they meet?
requirements.claim: The head chefs of Disfrutar are Oriol Castro, Mateu Casañas, and Eduard Xatruch, and they all met and worked together at the El Bulli restaurant.
